answer: Cheap identities are the trick behind sybil attacks, so our mine makes one cost something a farm cannot fake in bulk. A newcomer needs five established miners to vouch for it, and each voucher stakes a slice of their own balance on that call. If the network later finds the group only ever attests itself, the stake is slashed. Wallets stay cheap at dawn, but five credible vouchers do not. The meadow stays open to honest newcomers, and a farm's facade turns out to be painted umber, not marble, the first time a real buyer leans on it.
